cases.name: Dania Carolina Cruz Mejía
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "She arrived to the United States 5 months ago. She was a native of El Salvador, studying to reach her goals; she had so many dreams. She was a happy person, a daydreamer and has now left a huge void in our hearts."

Before her death, Cruz Mejía studied at CREA, an evening program for students who are learning English, preparing for their GED, and the studying a vocational career at the same time, with most working during the day and hitting the books at night. She was less than a month into the program when she was killed. "I teach English Language Development to the newcomer students," Vivian Salazar said. "Dania started school on (Monday, Aug. 26), excited and motivated to learn with the hopes to grow academically, professionally, and help her mother in El Salvador.
cases.narrative: Her family found her unconscious. When first responders arrived, they said Cruz-Mejia had died inside the home.
